# V108 CPU slot-write integration and quantized component qualification

The default-off CPU update is now wired through model configuration and complete slot-load batches. It uses the same private joined read batches, reservations, pinning, mapping publication and synchronization as the reference. Only the MLX update stream changes, with CPU slices for up to two contiguous runs and CPU indexed scatter otherwise. A fresh array context lets MLX preserve aliases and donate exclusive storage. Conflicting CPU/word/slice environment selections are rejected. Per-request prefill/decode CPU batch counters expose whether it ran.

All 3,113 CPU integration assertions pass: 187 component/configuration/invalid-shape checks, 164 pool reservation/byte checks, 1,322 storage and checked-read failure assertions, 1,129 full-state/ordered-route/continuation checks, and 151 ordinary plus 160 MTP request-recovery assertions. Invalid bytes and failed reads are not published as valid expert mappings. The named quantized/SiLU component successor separately passes all 55 assertions, giving 3,168 passing assertions across this batch. The dense B/A counterexample remains excluded in its entirety; no compute performance measurement has run.

The CPU serving protocol is frozen below after checking all prerequisite receipts against this exact binary. It declares seven alternating pairs at the 8.1 GB / 640-slot floor, 17 raw prompt tokens and 16 greedy outputs, one full warmup per fresh process, MTP/prefix off and common compact state/final-forward/row embeddings. At least five clean pairs, 5% median client reduction and 80% positive pairs are required, with exact IDs/text, eight equal-work counters, measured CPU batch counters, nominal thermal/power, no interval swap and a sampled physical peak within target. Symmetric 60-second reserved cooldowns and no replacement rounds are specified. This record contains no CPU performance result.

Ordinary combined integration on V108 is running separately at this capture. V107 combined MTP already passed 181 assertions; final combined performance, defaults and planner credit remain pending. Further SiLU component coverage with non-power-of-two multipliers and varying finite BF16 pairs has been prepared in source after the V108 freeze and is not part of these 55 assertions.
